**Edit the map layer by layer.** The new Layer tool (Underground group) shows the 2D map cut at a height — PageUp and PageDown move it a layer, Shift eight — with rock, caves, water, lava and the blocks' colours, and its brush digs, fills with a block, pours water or lava or paints a cave biome on that layer or on the layers around it, as a ball with a round brush. Each stroke is one step to undo. Caves made by the terrain graph show there too, and what you fix by hand stays when the graph is applied again.
